name: duopore-public-unit-margin-worksheet
description: See how much is left from each sale after the item costs you enter.
keywords: see what is left per item

interface.shortDescription: See what is left per item
interface.longDescription: See how much is left from each sale after the item costs you enter. Add the sale price, purchase cost, packing, order-handling costs and payment fee. See the amount left per item and its share of the sale price. Use this to compare price plans. Tax, fixed business costs and any costs you leave out are not included.
capabilities: See what is left per item
defaultPrompt: How much is left per sale after these product costs?
Compare the margin for these product price plans.

positive.prompt: Use Unit Margin Worksheet with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"products":[{"sku":"001","sellingPrice":50,"purchaseCost":20,"packagingCost":2,"fulfillmentCost":5,"feePercent":3}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"0 of 1 scenarios have negative unit contribution.","rows":[{"sku":"001","sellingPrice":50,"totalUnitCost":28.5,"paymentFee":1.5,"unitContribution":21.5,"marginPercent":43}],"warnings":["Excludes tax, fixed overhead and omitted costs.","Zero selling price has no defined margin percentage."]}
